author: rishiexplainsai
caption:
Claude Code can now make short films in 66 different styles, and there is no video model behind it.

It’s called Lemo-Opuscar, a free, open-source Claude Code plugin. You name a style, describe the film in one prompt, and Claude writes the story, draws every shot in code, scores the music, adds the sound effects and puts the whole film together.

The honest catch: it takes Claude about 30 to 60 minutes per film, and a fair amount of tokens.

Comment STYLE and I’ll send you the link. Save this reel so you can try it later.
